functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sg_slugify_lead_source_name(p_name text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
      SELECT COALESCE(
        NULLIF(
          trim(both '_' from regexp_replace(lower(trim(COALESCE(p_name, 'autre'))), '[^a-z0-9]+', '_', 'g')),
          ''
        ),
        'autre'
      );
    $function$
